messages:
Sasha: quick idea — instead of trying to bolt more fields onto the main ingest pipeline, what if we push attribution proofs into a small sidecar stream that gets written with the same ordering guarantees as events?
Mira: sidecar stream = separate topic + compact proof blobs? curious how you see ordering guaranteed without coupling to ingest. :thinking:
Sasha: yes — two-phase write pattern. ingest writes event to primary topic, then sidecar writer emits a tiny proof packet that references event id + fingerprint + attribution hints. consumers can validate proofs and stitch later. keeps ledger format simple.
Kevin: hmm. main win is decoupling heavy enrichment from critical path, right? but how do we avoid losing proofs if sidecar lags behind? billing must be exact.
Sasha: we add a configurable grace window for finalization plus a compact tombstone/reconciliation job. producers should attempt local retry; broker-level retention keeps sidecar around. worst-case we mark tokens "pending-provenance" and reconcile.
Jamie: can you sketch the proof blob shape? small and fixed-ish.
Sasha: idea: {"event_id","fingerprint","attribution_vector","checksum","producer_seq"} — packed and optionally signed. keeping it binary+base64 for size.
Mira: signatures might be overkill initially. can we rely on broker+audit job to surface mismatches?
Sasha: agree signatures optional for first pass. but include checksum and producer_seq so we can detect reorder/dup.
Sasha: example compact config we discussed in spike:
```
sidecar:
  topic: metering.sidecar.v1
  retention: 7d
  max_blob_size: 1024
  finalization_grace_s: 300
```
Kevin: looks practical. audit job would join primary + sidecar by event_id and emit accounting-ready rows. how do we handle chunked/streamed requests where a single user message spawns many token events?
Sasha: sidecar can carry a small token-range descriptor (start_idx, end_idx) + cumulative units. that way the audit join can expand ranges into accounting rows. keeps per-token traffic off main topic.
Jamie: what about late attribution changes (post-hoc corrections)? we need an append-only trail for audits, not destructive updates.
Sasha: sidecar proofs are append-only; corrections are emit-correction packets that reference original proof id and delta. audit join applies corrections in order.
Mira: curious about cost delta vs current enriched event model. extra messages = extra ingress egress. do we have rough numbers?
Sasha: rough: proof blob ~200 bytes avg => ~0.2KB per event. at 200M events/month that's ~40GB — small vs model traffic. plus simpler main pipeline should reduce CPU for enrichers.
Jamie: sounds reasonable. failure modes to document: sidecar gap, out-of-order, faulty producer_seq, verification mismatches. propose we add auto-failover to fallback accounting mode (count-only) if reconciliation fails for tenant > threshold.
Kevin: operationally: need dashboards for sidecar lag, proof rejection rate, correction churn. also a backfill tool to replay proofs for windows.
Sasha: agreed. propose spike: 2-week prototype that implements sidecar producer library + joiner audit job + minimal UI metrics. goal: validate recon rates and perf.
billing-bot: NOTE: spike will need a temporary feature flag and billing team review for "pending-provenance" semantics. Please loop in @Jamie by EOD.
Mira: sgtm. Jamie can you own the billing semantics review?
Jamie: can do. will validate with legal and finance on how pending tokens show up in invoices.
Sasha: ok — next steps: 1) prototype producer lib (Sasha), 2) audit-join job PoC (Kevin), 3) metrics + UI hooks (Mira), 4) billing semantics (Jamie). sync in 1w.
Kevin: noted. starting spike infra tomorrow.
Mira: tagging docs/eng-platform to reserve a short RFC follow-up slot after the spike. :+1:
Sasha: thanks all. recording this thread as the spike scope.
